comparator.sourceNotes: Current Dutch full-time ACTA Bachelor Tandheelkunde, RIO 56560, joint VU/UvA faculty; exact VU registry target unit 1001O5917/source row126. OER2026–27 adopted11August2026, effective1September2026 and applies to all registered students irrespective of entry year (A1.1). Annual curriculum used for2026entrant basis; no guarantee of future annual editions. Single named Bachelor Tandheelkunde route (10.2); no specialist route or free-programme substitution. Art11.3 and current guide agree:10 Year1 units60EC,12 Year2 units60EC,11 Year3 units60EC, all compulsory=180EC. No restricted/open elective space in this standard curriculum; old1ECvrije ruimte removed. ZeroEC Dutch diagnostic test is integrated in Introductie: pass test or remedial course before grade. Clinical/practical attendance at least90%; mandatory workgroups per programme; sufficient preparatory preclinical practicals before patient treatment. Clinical gap6months requires competence examination, nonpatient then patient components both sufficient. 9.1: Year2 Prevention line andTV2A require Oral Biology/Cariology,Direct Restorations,TV1A passed plus all New Patient practicals inTV1B attended;TV2B requires those blocks plusTV1A/1B passed andTV2A attended. Year3 Prevention/Treatment requires Year2 Prevention,CarePlanning,PeriodontitisI andPreventionline/TV2A/2B passed. Researchplacement requires Year1ResearchMethods/Statistics andYear2ResearchPreparation passed. Year1/2 have prescribed order; Year3 otherwise no sequence.14EC Wetenschappelijke stage includes supervised dental/related biomedical project or extended literature study, thesis and oral presentation/defence; execution50%,thesis30%,presentation20%, each sufficient; AI accountability statement in thesis. EvidenceBasedDentistry recommended, not formal prerequisite. Professionalconduct1EC is included, not extra; assessment continues across study. BSA42firstyearEC with5year exclusion afternegative advice. Preclinical exams normally2attempts;2026–27third opportunity if passrate below85%. Preclinical result validity4years; otherresults/exemptions limited if knowledge demonstrablychanged;boardextension possible. Art12 free individuallyapproved degree requires firstyearpassed and14ECthesis but is a distinct non-dentist pathway without dentalmaster access; not instantiated here. Honours extra. PDF visible2026–27 headers match extracted text; old2020–21content superseded. Programme marketing now targets2027–28 and supplies qualitative interests only, not2026credit rules. Course API researchassessment mistakenly calls its block Wetenschappelijke verdieping; code T_B3WSTAGE/name/14EC/current prerequisites match OER, so no masterblock is imported.

exception.reason: UCR supplies genuine biomedical foundations (cell biology, physiology, biochemistry, pharmacology, infection/immunity and pathology), laboratory methods, epidemiology, health psychology and statistics. Those contributions do not establish a substantive programme response to dentistry. ACTA combines sustained oral biology/cariology/periodontology, direct and indirect restorations, endodontology, dental care planning and medically complex patient study with 62EC of named dental skills/prevention-treatment/radiology lines, plus the14EC dental research placement. UCR has no taught course in these defining dental subjects or dental clinical/manual techniques. Functional Anatomy explicitly offers academic learning, not clinical skills; its named regions do not establish dental-arch/occlusion teaching. Mechanisms of Disease covers cardiovascular,lung,kidney,digestive,endocrine andCNS systems, not a caries course. Psychodiagnostics concerns mental-health assessment/psychotherapy, not oral diagnosis. Rhetoric with schoolchildren, general leadership, civil-society sociology, environmental justice and public economics cannot supply missing dental treatment, oral-health service design or patient-care competencies. First proposal has11biomedical/publichealth/lab courses82.5EC plus psychology/methods/rhetoric/law/PPD; the second has only4biomedical/publichealth courses30EC plus psychology and social/policy companions. Whole7.5EC course contributions are credited as actually taught, not relabelled as dentistry. Biomedical science/health equity can be coherent UCR programmes but address different targets; diversification cannot repair absent dental substance. This judgment is about academic content and weight, independently of professional licensing or direct master admission. Full151course workbook search for dental/orofacial/cariology/periodontal/endodontic/restorative/oralhealth terminology found no defining specialist course, and all35selected profiles were read. No defensible alternative or invented schedule retained.

registryRow.evidence: The bachelor directly invites students who want to help people improve their health through dentistry.
registryRow.source_title: Bachelor Tandheelkunde - Academisch Centrum Tandheelkunde Amsterdam

interestConstructionAssessment.finding: Oral health improvement is central; general biomedical/public-health study contributes background, not oral care practice.

registryRow.student_interest: looking beyond teeth to the whole patient
registryRow.evidence: ACTA stresses that dentists should understand each patient as a unique person rather than only treating teeth.
registryRow.source_title: Bachelor Tandheelkunde - Academisch Centrum Tandheelkunde Amsterdam || Bachelor Tandheelkunde - Inhoud - Academisch Centrum Tandheelkunde Amsterdam

interestConstructionAssessment.finding: Whole-patient approach explicitly supported; psychology is relevant but does not replace integrated dental-medical assessment.

registryRow.evidence: The programme presents dentistry as the integration of patient care, scientific knowledge and technical skill.
registryRow.source_title: Bachelor Tandheelkunde - Academisch Centrum Tandheelkunde Amsterdam || Bachelor Tandheelkunde - Inhoud - Academisch Centrum Tandheelkunde Amsterdam

interestConstructionAssessment.finding: Science, technique and communication are integrated in dentistry; generic data/biomedicine alone does not implement dental technology.

registryRow.evidence: Students learn to assess oral health scientifically before choosing a treatment.
registryRow.source_title: Bachelor Tandheelkunde - Academisch Centrum Tandheelkunde Amsterdam

interestConstructionAssessment.finding: Oral diagnosis supported by current competencies; psychodiagnostics is a different clinical field.

registryRow.evidence: The programme explicitly teaches students to involve patients in developing treatment plans.
registryRow.source_title: Bachelor Tandheelkunde - Academisch Centrum Tandheelkunde Amsterdam

interestConstructionAssessment.finding: Shared treatment planning is explicit; rhetoric is not dental care-plan design.

registryRow.evidence: Prevention is central to the programme’s model of dentistry.
registryRow.source_title: Bachelor Tandheelkunde - Academisch Centrum Tandheelkunde Amsterdam

interestConstructionAssessment.finding: Prevention explicit; epidemiology is relevant population background, not caries/periodontal clinical prevention.

registryRow.evidence: ACTA describes the dentist as a scientifically informed problem-solver.
registryRow.source_title: Bachelor Tandheelkunde - Academisch Centrum Tandheelkunde Amsterdam

interestConstructionAssessment.finding: Clinical problem solving explicit; generic disease reasoning lacks dental diagnostic/treatment progression.

registryRow.evidence: Students learn to collect, assess and apply scientific information in oral care.

registryRow.evidence: The curriculum explicitly integrates clinical skill development with theory and science.

registryRow.evidence: The programme identifies spatial insight, dexterity and precision as qualities developed for dental practice.

audience.programmeDescription: ACTA Dentistry combines oral biology and disease, restorative and preventive dentistry, scientific research and sustained dental skills training. Students progress from preclinical work to supervised patient treatment, care planning and work with medically complex patients. ACTA is the joint dental faculty of VU Amsterdam and the University of Amsterdam.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers useful biomedical science, laboratory methods, public health and health psychology. These courses do not provide the sustained dental knowledge, oral diagnosis, restoration techniques and patient-treatment progression that define this degree. We therefore show the verified ACTA curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

curriculum.limitation: All 180 EC are compulsory; the standard curriculum has no open minor or elective space. The 14-EC research placement includes a thesis and oral defence and requires the first-year methods course and second-year research preparation. Dutch language testing is an integrated introduction-course requirement. Dental prerequisites, at least 90% practical attendance and professional-conduct requirements apply. Positive first-year study advice requires 42 EC.
